post Products Product Management post Copy Page Getting Started with Our APIs Merchant Sign-Up Onboard merchants through a complete application workflow. Submit applications for automated risk review, monitor approval status in real-time, and retrieve provisioned Gateway and Merchant IDs. The API supports full lifecycle management including authentication, package configuration, and webhook notifications for application events. If you already have a merchant account and just need to board it directly to the gateway use the Account Management section below. Payment Processing Process transactions seamlessly across a wide range of payment methods, including card-present, e-commerce, and alternative payment options like Apple Pay and Google Pay. Beyond transaction processing, manage the complete payment experience including invoicing, recurring billing, and secure payment storage. Build flexible payment solutions that support both online and in-person transactions. Account Management Onboard merchants to the gateway, configure processors and services, manage fee schedules and settlement timing, and enable secure payment features like Customer Token Vault and Apple Pay. Build fully white-label payment experiences with full control over merchant accounts and gateway settings tailored to your needs. Reporting Robust reporting capabilities, allowing merchants to access detailed transaction, customer, invoice, and account data. Generate custom reports tailored to your business needs and gain actionable insights into payment activity, merchant performance, and account metrics. Administration Manage API authentication, user access, and event-driven integrations. Configure webhooks for real-time notifications and build automated workflows with retry logic and event monitoring. Updated 3 months ago MCP Server Did this page help you?
